ARCH 500.title: Architectural Design Studio I
ARCH 500.description: A series of projects focusing on conceptual development, design synthesis, principles of typology, organization and representation.

ARCH 503.title: Architecture and Society Through the Ages
ARCH 503.description: Key debates and questions in the field of architecture.

ARCH 504.title: Topics in Architectural History I (Pre-1900)
ARCH 504.description: History of architecture in the pre-1900 time period. Technological, political, social, and economic changes that have influenced architecture and related fields.

ARCH 505.title: Topics in Architectural History II (1900-Present)
ARCH 505.description: History of architecture in the post-1900 time period. Technological, political, social, and economic changes which have influenced architecture and related fields.

ARCH 511.title: Architectural Technology I
ARCH 511.description: Architectural technology, including materials and methods, construction types, and building system integration. Strong emphasis on enclosure performance with focus on smaller buildings and light wood framing construction.

ARCH 512.title: Structures I
ARCH 512.description: Quantitative and qualitative means for understanding of statics, materials and flow of force through a structure.

ARCH 513.title: Environmental Systems and Controls I
ARCH 513.description: Building form and fabric considerations to assure appropriate thermal, luminous, sonic, and atmospheric conditions within buildings.

ARCH 515.title: Design Media I
ARCH 515.description: Foundations of manual and digital skills and concepts employing a variety of subjects, techniques and software.

ARCH 517.title: Design Media II
ARCH 517.description: Intermediate manual and digital skills and concepts employing a variety of subjects, techniques and software.

ARCH 521.title: Architectural Design Studio IV
ARCH 521.prerequisiteText: All of ARCH_V 511, ARCH_V 512, ARCH_V 513, ARCH_V 520

ARCH 522.title: Current Issues in Architecture
ARCH 522.description: A seminar examining current issues in Architecture, based on reading assignments, papers and presentations. Enrolment is limited to facilitate discussion.

ARCH 523.title: Contemporary Theories in Architecture
ARCH 523.description: Theoretical propositions and their built manifestations.

ARCH 531.title: Architectural Technology II
ARCH 531.description: Analysis and design of advanced assemblies. Integration of multiple building systems within a wide range of construction types, and more complex enclosures in a variety of climatic conditions. Emphasis on technical performance, durability and sustainability.

ARCH 532.title: Architectural Structures II
ARCH 532.description: Complex multi-span and continuous systems: effective material configuration, approximate methods of analysis, selection of appropriate structural systems, earthquake configuration and high rises.

ARCH 533.title: Environmental Systems and Controls II
ARCH 533.description: Mechanical and electrical services of buildings and their integration with architectural form and fabric.

ARCH 537.title: International Exchange in Architecture
ARCH 537.description: Pass/Fail. Pre-approved studies in architecture in an international context.

ARCH 538.title: Study of Architecture Abroad
ARCH 538.description: More than one section may be taken concurrently.

ARCH 539.title: Architectural Design Abroad
ARCH 539.description: Design studio component of term-long study abroad offering.

ARCH 541.title: Professional Practice
ARCH 541.description: Ethical, legal and business context of professional practice, including contracts, project management.

ARCH 543.title: Seminar: Contemporary Practice
ARCH 543.description: Topics across a range of practice related subject matter.

ARCH 544.title: Seminar in Architecture
ARCH 544.description: An in-depth study of a selected topic in architecture.

ARCH 545.title: Directed Studies in Architecture
ARCH 545.description: Directed research and exploration of selected topics in architecture.

ARCH 548.title: Graduate Project Part I
ARCH 548.description: Preparation of a graduation design project including literature review.
ARCH 548.prerequisiteText: All of ARCH_V 521, ARCH_V 523, ARCH_V 531, ARCH_V 532, ARCH_V 533

ARCH 549.title: Graduate Project Part II
ARCH 549.description: Design component, completion, and defense of the graduation design project. Honours/Pass/Fail.

children.raw: no more than 18 credits outstanding beyond

ARCH 549.prerequisiteText: ARCH_V 548 and no more than 18 credits outstanding beyond ARCH_V 549

ARCH 551.title: Communicating Construction
ARCH 551.description: Understanding the role, composition, organization, and conventions of the formal documentation necessary for communication of an architectural design to those undertaking the construction.

ARCH 555.title: Co-operative Education
ARCH 555.description: Approved and supervised work experience in an established company or organization for a minimum of one academic term. Technical report required.

ARCH 561.title: Seminar: History and Theory
ARCH 561.description: Topics across a range of history/theory-based subject matter.

ARCH 571.title: Seminar: Technology and Analysis
ARCH 571.description: Topics across a range of building material and construction technology-based subject matter.

ARCH 572.title: Research Seminar: Advanced Structure and Generative Methods
ARCH 572.description: Structural principles and corresponding mathematical representation as three- and four-dimensional digital models using structural analysis software.

ARCH 573.title: Seminar: Environmental Studies
ARCH 573.description: An investigation of specialized environmental topics concerning theory and the practice of architecture.

ARCH 574.title: Green Building Contemporary Practice
ARCH 574.description: Enhanced building environmental performance and the integration of green building principles, strategies and technologies.

ARCH 575.title: Regenerative Development
ARCH 575.description: The relationship between human and natural systems in the context of regenerative design. Provides an understanding of how regenerative approaches differ from green design and how they can offer new insights and directions for design.

ARCH 597.title: Special Topics
ARCH 597.description: Individual or small group study of special topics.
